parent_objective: design interpolation trust-region replay preflight for M1346 update direction
blocked_by: M1350 rejects raw M1346 but leaves open whether a smaller interpolation preserves replay while improving exact objective metrics
supersedes: direct replay-aware repair before checking alpha trust region

public_gates: M1351 must not use private holdout
M1351 must preserve actor input contract
M1351 must design exact objective and replay gates for interpolated candidates
forbidden_shortcuts: do not skip exact objective checks

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs a trust-region interpolation check for an objective-positive but replay-negative update direction
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: process design only; no promotion, private-holdout, PPO, closed-loop, paper-level, high-fidelity, or strong self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if design promotes an interpolation from fixed objective metrics alone
stop if design skips M267/M264 replay
fallback_plan: if design is clean, route to interpolation preflight implementation
if interpolation tooling already exists, use existing checkpoint interpolation helpers
if interpolation is insufficient, route to replay-aware active-set repair design
if exact metrics are too expensive, route to evaluator batching improvement
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1350 routes proof washout to interpolation preflight design

admission_evidence: M1346 improves exact metrics but raw update fails M267/M264
M1350 classifies likely control variable as update amplitude or trust region
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review
next_stage_criteria: exact objective and replay ordering is specified

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1351 designs trust-region checks and cannot claim stronger self-identification.
history_necessity_tests: design requires M267/M264 wrong-history replay retention after exact source-history objective checks
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1346 fixed objective metrics and M1349 replay failure.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If no interpolation passes replay with objective lift, record the direction as unusable and route to replay-aware objective repair.
allowed_claims: no strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, high-fidelity validation, real-vehicle, paper-result, or closed-loop driver claim

hypothesis: A trust-region interpolation protocol can determine whether the M1346 objective direction has a usable small-alpha region before replay-aware repair.
success_criteria: design specifies exact source-history metric gates before replay
design specifies M267/M264 and conditional M183/M170 replay gates
no training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, threshold relaxation, actor update, replay run, or actor-input expansion occurs
failure_criteria: design routes directly to PPO or promotion
training, PPO, private holdout, promotion, threshold relaxation, actor update, replay run, or actor-input expansion occurs
decision_rule: M1351 passes as a design milestone only if it specifies a bounded interpolation preflight and keeps training, PPO, private holdout, promotion, replay execution, and actor-input changes blocked.
